name: File Operations
description: Comprehensive file and directory operations with safety checks and error handling

functions.name: read_file
functions.description: Read a single file with comprehensive safety checks and encoding fallback

file_path.description: Path to the file to read

encoding.description: Primary encoding to try (defaults to utf-8)

max_size_mb.description: Maximum file size in MB (defaults to 10.0)

functions.returns: Dict with file content, metadata, or error details

functions.name: read_multiple_files
functions.description: Read multiple files with progress tracking and error handling

file_paths.description: List of file paths to read

fail_fast.description: Stop on first error if True

functions.returns: Dict with batch read results and summary

functions.name: list_directory
functions.description: List directory contents with metadata and sorting
functions.returns: Dict with directory listing and metadata

functions.name: search_files
functions.description: Search for files and directories matching pattern

pattern.description: Search pattern to match against names

functions.returns: Dict with search results and metadata

functions.name: get_file_info
functions.description: Get comprehensive file information and metadata

file_path.description: Path to file or directory to analyze

functions.name: move_file
functions.description: Move or rename files and directories safely

overwrite.description: Allow overwriting existing files if True

functions.returns: Dict with operation results or error details

functions.name: delete_file

file_path.description: Path to file or directory to delete

force.description: Force deletion of directories and their contents

functions.returns: Dict with operation results or error details

functions.name: validate_paths
functions.description: Validate multiple file paths and return status information

paths.description: List of file paths to validate

functions.returns: Dict with validation results for each path
